card.situation: Sources Sought RFI for AFLCMC AEROS — comprehensive 24/7/365 functional and technical operations support for Air Mobility Command's Rapid Global Mobility C2 system portfolio, including legacy and next-gen applications, mission partner data feeds, and on-site support at a designated Government facility. Reached the owner because Sooner Systems is a Total Small Business under NAICS 541512 (exact match), holds Security+/IAT Level II certifications, and operates a 24x7 NOC — triggering multiple partial matches against core requirements.
reasons_for: Firm's 24x7 NOC in Norman, OK and Tier 1–3 help desk capability directly address the round-the-clock functional and technical operations support desk requirement [ee15f287-d29cc445-p3-d7784e6a].
Security+ held across the bench satisfies the DoDD 8140.01 IAT Level II certification mandate for all technical support desk personnel [ee15f287-d29cc445-p6-d5a34af5].

Two qualifying past-performance records (Army Corps help desk; FAA cybersecurity) demonstrate relevant IT operations and government-system-interaction experience that can be highlighted in the capability statement [profile: past performance, IT help desk and desktop support | US Army Corps of Engineers, Tulsa District].
reasons_against: No SMEs with AFTRANS, AMC, or Air Force C2 operational domain knowledge are documented, leaving a hard gap against the requirement for SMEs who understand the operational intent behind the tasks [ee15f287-d29cc445-p2-8eda4cba].

Firm's NOC is in Norman, OK with no evidence of on-site presence at a designated Government facility (Scott AFB, IL), requiring new investment to meet the on-site support desk mandate [ee15f287-d29cc445-p3-d7784e6a].

No experience with MAF C2 development team coordination, change management processes, or mission partner data feeds is documented, representing critical scope gaps for this enterprise C2 program [ee15f287-d29cc445-p5-ebdb9233].

drafts.capability_statement:
Sooner Systems LLC — Capability Statement
Air Force Enterprise Rapid Operations Support (AEROS) | Notice ee15f287bd3049349277a9bd31c206df

Sooner Systems LLC is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) and SBA-recognized small business under NAICS 541512, fully eligible under the Total Small Business set-aside for AEROS.

We deliver Tier 1–3 functional and technical IT operations support from a 24x7 Network Operations Center (NOC) in Norman, OK, providing the always-on coverage model AEROS requires. Our help desk staff hold ITIL 4 certifications across the bench, enabling structured SOP development, incident triage, and escalation protocols aligned to high-severity operational environments. All technical support desk personnel hold CompTIA Security+, satisfying DoDD 8140.01 IAT Level II requirements.

Our 22 Secret-cleared staff support classified-environment work, and our CMMC Level 2 self-assessed posture demonstrates a mature cybersecurity compliance foundation. RMF/ATO documentation experience supports government-provided environment compliance obligations.

Relevant past performance includes:
• IT Help Desk and Desktop Support — U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Tulsa District (NAICS 541512, 2022–2025): Tier 1–2 service desk, ITIL-based ticketing, and end-user support.
• Network Administration and Cybersecurity Support — FAA Mike Monroney Aeronautical Center (NAICS 541519, 2021–2024): NOC monitoring, RMF/ATO, SIEM/SOAR, incident response, and government-system interaction.

Sooner Systems is prepared to scale staffing, establish on-site presence at the designated Government facility, and develop AFTRANS-domain SME capability to meet AEROS requirements. We welcome the opportunity to discuss our fit with the AFLCMC C3BM OL-2 team.
questions_for_co: Regarding the SME operational-domain requirement [ee15f287-d29cc445-p2-8eda4cba]: Will the Government consider offerors who propose a teaming or hiring plan to develop AFTRANS/AMC C2 operational domain expertise, or is demonstrated prior experience with Air Force C2 or AFTRANS applications a mandatory qualifier for award?

Regarding enterprise-level global management and theater-specific agility [ee15f287-d29cc445-p2-952e3551]: Can the Government describe the specific AFTRANS System Portfolio applications and mission partner interfaces that SMEs must be proficient in at contract start, versus those for which on-the-job or government-provided training will be available during transition?

Regarding the on-site support desk requirement [ee15f287-d29cc445-p3-d7784e6a]: Is the designated Government facility exclusively Scott AFB, IL, or will the Government consider a hybrid model that combines an on-site presence with a contractor-operated remote NOC for after-hours or surge coverage?

Regarding Mission Essential Personnel (MEP) designation [ee15f287-d29cc445-p4-0545092f]: How many contractor positions are anticipated to carry MEP designation, and will the Government provide facility access, billeting, or other support to MEP personnel required to report during weather or security events?

Regarding MAF C2 change management coordination [ee15f187-d29cc445-p5-ebdb9233]: Will the Government provide access to existing MAF C2 change management process documentation and the MAF C2 development team during the transition period, and is familiarity with those processes expected at proposal submission or achievable through post-award onboarding?

Regarding contract size and scope: Can the Government share an anticipated period of performance, estimated contract value range, or number of FTE positions envisioned, to help small businesses assess whether teaming arrangements are appropriate for AEROS?

reader.scope_summary: AFLCMC C3BM OL-2 is executing Software Development Lifecyle Management for Air Mobility Command's (AMC) Rapid Global Mobility Command and Control (RGM C2) Program, that leverages technical solutions and practices for all Air Force Transportation (AFTRANS) operations. The Contractor shall provide comprehensive functional and technical operations support of critical command and control (C2) capabilities within a government-provided environment, including 24/7/365 support focused on the System Portfolio applications, all supporting environment components, and the mission partner data feeds that are critical to the operational capabilities within the System Portfolio architecture. The support model must be capable of supporting both centralized global strategic planning and decentralized, theater-specific tactical execution across all time zones, covering both legacy and Next Generation modernized system portfolio applications.
quotes: The Contractor shall establish and sustain a 24/7/365 Support Desk at designated Government facility that provides functional and technical operations support services for the System Portfolio applications.
The Support Desk shall be staffed with both funct ional and technical SMEs that are able to support the complex System Portfolio applications and the interaction with mission partners.
Technical support desk personnel shall possess relevant, current DODD 8140.01 compliant certifications (e.g., Sec+) and maintain IAT Level II certification.
The Contractor must provide Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) who understand not just the software, but the operational intent behind the tasks.

This distributed user base dictates that the vendor support model must be capable of supporting both centralized global strategic planning and decentralized, theater-specific tactical execution across all time zones.
Consequently, the Operations Support Desk (OSD) must be proficient in high -severity triage and immediate escalation protocols that account for both global and regional mission priorities.
A successful vendor must implement robus t training pipelines to ensure their staff remains proficient in these unique interfaces.
The Contractor shall support the migration and continuous modernization of systems supporting the capabilities within the government provided environment.
The solicitation is anticipated to be posted during the first quarter of the 2027 calendar year.
Responses to this RFI shall be submitted no later than 5:00PM ET on Wednesday 30 September 2026.
Responses shall not exceed 5 single -sided pages (excluding the cover page).
